description: [PAID $0.005 USDC/call, x402, eip155:8453] Compare supplied numeric catalogue fields aligned by exact product, variant, field ID and required locale. Explicit decimal separator, Unicode decimal digits, no grouping; exact mg/g/kg, ml/l and mm/cm/m conversions. Up to 1000 records, 100 fields/record, 5000 total fields and 10000 comparisons. Missing/unknown/noncomparable values stay explicit. No prose extraction, semantic translation evaluation, currency conversion or catalogue edits. EOA EIP-712 payments only; ERC-1271/6492 unsupported. MCP body max 64 KiB. Experimental price; input facts are not authenticated.
name: multilingual_quantity_check
